title: Portrait In Union Square
content: Yesterday in New York City I did this stealth portrait of a guy on his cellphone. In the video I captured the moment as he walked away. If you receive this post by email, you may need tofollow this link to see the video.The sketch is in watercolor and gouache in aPentalic Aqua journal, and the guy was sitting there for about 45 minutes.-----Watercolor in the Wild materials
